info.title: mashbox server
info.description: The HTTP server `mashbox run <model>` starts on 127.0.0.1 (reach it from your machine with an SSH tunnel). It speaks the OpenAI Chat Completions, Completions and Responses APIs and the Anthropic Messages API, so OpenAI and Anthropic clients and coding agents work against it unchanged. On 127.0.0.1 no API key is checked and any key a client sends is ignored; with `--api-key-file` or `MASHBOX_API_KEY`, and always when `--host` is not loopback, `/v1` routes, `/metrics` and `/openapi.json` need a key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`; 401 without). POST bodies must be `Content-Type: application/json` (415 otherwise), and a request from a web page of another origin, or naming the server by a host name it does not answer to, gets 403. Fields a route does not list are accepted and ignored.

get.description: 200 when the model is loaded and the server takes requests, 503 while it loads. GET /health is the same.

head.description: 200 when ready, 503 while loading, no body. The server answers HEAD the same way on every path.

post.description: OpenAI Chat Completions with function tools, thinking and streaming. Coding agents such as Pi use it.

404.description: A model id other than the one this server serves (GET /v1/models), code model_not_found. Leaving model out is accepted.

429.description: Too many requests are waiting for a slot: 32 of yours (per tenant: keys the key file names with one tenant share it, a key without a name is its own tenant; without keys, 32 in all), or the server's queue is full (256 waiting in all). Retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

500.description: The request failed on the device: its one retry failed too, or it failed after its stream had sent output. A request whose client has received nothing is sent again (once, from the start): not streamed, until its response is written; streamed, until its first output is sent. A stream that has sent output is never retried by the server, since a second run could repeat what the client already has; it ends with the route's error event instead, carrying the response id as request_id.

503.description: The model is still loading. Retry after the Retry-After header's seconds.

get.description: What the server does, in the Prometheus text format: requests running and waiting, KV cache use, the cache layout (one slot holds one whole context: block_size = the context length, num_blocks = the slots), requests answered by finish reason, prompt and generated tokens, prefix cache lookups and hits (tokens), preemptions (never), worker restarts, programs compiled after ready, and histograms of time to first token, queue time, end-to-end time and time per output token. Every name starts with `mashbox:`. No label names a user, an API key or a session.
The OpenAPI 3.1 description of this server, with the running model's id.

status.description: ok when the model is loaded, loading before (and while its worker restarts).

cache_bytes.description: Bytes the prompt cache holds in host memory: host_cache_bytes plus snapshot_bytes, each copy counted once.

host_cache_bytes.description: Bytes of the host memory prompt cache, each copy counted once.

snapshot_bytes.description: Bytes of saved slot state points that host_cache_bytes does not already count.

host_cache_cap_bytes.description: Most bytes the host memory prompt cache holds (0 = off).

host_cache_evictions.description: Prompt cache entries removed from host memory to stay under that cap.

cache_namespace.description: Id of what cached prompts are valid for: model, weights, tokenizer, chat template and cache policy.

deployment_id.description: Id of the compiled programs this server runs (null until set).

component_set_sha.description: Id of the model's component set (null until set).

certification.description: Whether this server's build passed the certification gate on its chip.

compiles_after_ready.description: Programs compiled since the server reported ready, in every worker process it has run (0 when the start-up warm-up compiled every program the requests ran; null before ready or where this process does not count them).

worker_pid.description: Process id of the model's worker, when the engine runs in a worker process.

worker_restarts.description: Times the worker was started again after a fault.

bpw.description: Bits per weight of the weights file.

prefix_cache.description: Whether the server reuses cached prompt starts.

cache_ram_mib.description: Host memory for saved prompt states (--cache-ram).

role.description: system and developer join the system prompt.

content.description: Text, or a list of text parts. Text parts only: image, audio and file parts are refused with 400 (text-only model).

model.description: Accepted for compatibility; the server answers with the one model it runs.

tools.description: Function tools the model may call.

stream.description: Stream the answer as server-sent events (see the 200 text/event-stream response). A client that reads nothing from the stream for 30 s is disconnected and its answer stops.

include_usage.description: Send a last chunk with usage.

merge.description: Accepted and ignored: every request joins the running batch at the next device call, and no request field changes how other requests are scheduled.

prompt_cache_key.description: Tags the request's session in the server log (as the X-Session-Id header does).

logprobs.description: Not supported (log probabilities): a request that sets it gets 400 naming the field.

top_logprobs.description: Not supported (log probabilities): a request that sets it gets 400 naming the field.

response_format.description: Only {"type": "text"}. Not supported: json_object and json_schema (structured output), answered with 400.

max_completion_tokens.description: Most new tokens (>= 1); max_tokens is the same. Default: up to the end of the context (--ctx).

top_k.description: Keep the k most likely tokens; 0 = off.

min_p.description: Drop tokens below min_p times the top probability, in [0, 1).

seed.description: Sampling seed; a random one when absent.

stop.description: A string or a list of non-empty strings; the text ends before the first one.

stop_sequences.description: Same as stop (Anthropic's name), used when stop is absent.

content.description: The answer (null when it only calls tools).

prompt_n.description: Prompt tokens prefilled (not served from the prefix cache).

prompt_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the run to the first new token.

predicted_ms.description: Milliseconds from the first to the last new token.

predicted_per_second.description: Decode speed: new tokens after the first, per second of predicted_ms.

cache_n.description: Prompt tokens served from the prefix cache.

queue_ms.description: Milliseconds the request waited before it ran.

ChatTimings.description: Server timings, the fields of llama-server's timings block.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the prefix cache.

ChatCompletionChunk.description: One `data:` line. The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`. With stream_options.include_usage the last chunk has empty choices and usage. The chunk with the finish_reason, and the usage chunk, carry timings.

model.description: Accepted for compatibility; the server answers with the one model it runs.

prompt.description: The text to continue (a string, or a list of one string).

stream.description: Stream the answer as server-sent events (see the 200 text/event-stream response). A client that reads nothing from the stream for 30 s is disconnected and its answer stops.

merge.description: Accepted and ignored: every request joins the running batch at the next device call, and no request field changes how other requests are scheduled.

prompt_cache_key.description: Tags the request's session in the server log (as the X-Session-Id header does).

logprobs.description: Not supported (log probabilities): a request that sets it gets 400 naming the field.

max_completion_tokens.description: Same as max_tokens (OpenAI's newer name); wins when both are set.

top_k.description: Keep the k most likely tokens; 0 = off.

min_p.description: Drop tokens below min_p times the top probability, in [0, 1).

seed.description: Sampling seed; a random one when absent.

stop.description: A string or a list of non-empty strings; the text ends before the first one.

stop_sequences.description: Same as stop (Anthropic's name), used when stop is absent.

text.description: The continuation (in a stream: new text).

finish_reason.description: stop or length; null until the last chunk.

Completion.description: Whole answer, or one `data:` line of a stream (no usage); the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.

model.description: Accepted for compatibility; the server answers with the one model it runs.

content.description: Text, or content blocks: text, thinking, tool_use, tool_result. Text parts only: image, audio and file parts are refused with 400 (text-only model).

system.description: System prompt: a string or text blocks.

type.description: custom or absent; server tools (web search and others) are refused.

tools.description: Client tools the model may call.

type.description: enabled or adaptive turns thinking on.

stream.description: Stream the answer as server-sent events (see the 200 text/event-stream response). A client that reads nothing from the stream for 30 s is disconnected and its answer stops.

prompt_cache_key.description: Tags the request's session in the server log (as the X-Session-Id header does).

output_config.description: effort is accepted and ignored. Not supported: format (structured output), answered with 400.

max_tokens.description: Most new tokens; default: up to the end of the context (--ctx).

max_completion_tokens.description: Same as max_tokens (OpenAI's newer name); wins when both are set.

top_k.description: Keep the k most likely tokens; 0 = off.

min_p.description: Drop tokens below min_p times the top probability, in [0, 1).

seed.description: Sampling seed; a random one when absent.

stop.description: A string or a list of non-empty strings; the text ends before the first one.

stop_sequences.description: Same as stop (Anthropic's name), used when stop is absent.

model.description: The model field of the request, else the model id.

stop_reason.description: end_turn, max_tokens, stop_sequence or tool_use; null in message_start.

stop_sequence.description: The stop sequence that ended the text.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens not served from the prefix cache.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the prefix cache.

type.description: Same as the SSE event name.

delta.description: text_delta, thinking_delta, signature_delta, input_json_delta; on message_delta: stop_reason and stop_sequence.

MessageStreamEvent.description: One `event:` + `data:` pair: message_start, ping, then per block content_block_start / _delta / _stop, then message_delta and message_stop.

model.description: Accepted for compatibility; the server answers with the one model it runs.

input_tokens.description: Prompt tokens after the chat template.

model.description: Accepted for compatibility; the server answers with the one model it runs.

input.description: A string, or items: message (system, developer, user, assistant), function_call, function_call_output, custom_tool_call, custom_tool_call_output, local_shell_call, local_shell_call_output, reasoning. Text parts only: image, audio and file parts are refused with 400 (text-only model).

items.description: function, custom (grammar given to the model as text) or namespace tools. Hosted tools (web_search, file_search, code_interpreter, image_generation, computer_use_preview, mcp, local_shell) are dropped: the model does not see them.

effort.description: Any value but none or minimal turns thinking on.

stream.description: Stream the answer as server-sent events (see the 200 text/event-stream response). A client that reads nothing from the stream for 30 s is disconnected and its answer stops.

prompt_cache_key.description: Tags the request's session in the server log (as the X-Session-Id header does).

include.description: Accepted and ignored, except an entry naming logprobs: 400 (log probabilities are not supported).

top_logprobs.description: Not supported (log probabilities): a request that sets it gets 400 naming the field.

text.description: Only format {"type": "text"}. Not supported: other formats (structured output), answered with 400.

max_output_tokens.description: Most new tokens; default: up to the end of the context (--ctx).

max_completion_tokens.description: Same as max_tokens (OpenAI's newer name); wins when both are set.

top_k.description: Keep the k most likely tokens; 0 = off.

min_p.description: Drop tokens below min_p times the top probability, in [0, 1).

seed.description: Sampling seed; a random one when absent.

stop.description: A string or a list of non-empty strings; the text ends before the first one.

stop_sequences.description: Same as stop (Anthropic's name), used when stop is absent.

status.description: completed, or incomplete when max_output_tokens ran out.

model.description: The model field of the request, else the model id.

usage.description: input_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, total_tokens; null while in progress.

content.description: message: output_text parts; reasoning: reasoning_text parts.

call_id.description: Call id to answer with an *_output item.

namespace.description: function_call: the namespace tool it came from.

type.description: Same as the SSE event name.

ResponseStreamEvent.description: One `event:` + `data:` pair. An error after the stream started is sent as event `error`, then `response.failed` (the response with status failed and its error).
